stock.description: Which vendor SKUs you store, and what they should be earning in rent.

requests.description: Stock changes awaiting a signature. On a SKU you warehouse, neither you nor the vendor can change the recorded quantity alone.

page.title: Inventory
page.description: Which vendor SKUs you have agreed to store, and at which of your locations.
page.searchHint: Type at least {{count}} characters to search.
page.filterDescription: Narrow the list to one of your locations.
page.emptyNoMatch: No stored SKUs match your filters.
page.emptyNoStock: You aren't storing any vendor SKUs yet.
page.emptyNoStockHint: A product appears here when a vendor sets it to ship from your warehouse instead of their own shop. That needs storage-based pricing switched on in your policies, and the vendor to pick it on the product.

derived.bannerTitle: "Counted on hand" is not a shelf count yet.
derived.bannerBody: Nobody has counted anything: stock isn't decremented when goods leave or restored on a return, and there's no intake flow — so those figures stay at zero until stock is reserved at checkout and settled on delivery. The agreed quantity beside them is real, and it's the one your storage rent is quoted against.
derived.tooltipBody: This row exists because the vendor configured the product to be stored with you. Stock isn't decremented when goods leave or restored on a return, and there's no intake flow — so there is no honest number to show.
derived.detailBody: This row exists because the vendor configured the product to be stored with you. Stock isn't decremented when goods leave or restored on a return, and there's no intake flow yet, so no quantity is shown. Real counts arrive with reservation at checkout and settlement on delivery.

catalogStock.title: Agreed quantity
catalogStock.label: Agreed with the vendor
catalogStock.caption: The catalogue quantity for this SKU. Neither of you can change it alone — one proposes, the other approves. Your storage rent is quoted against this figure.
catalogStock.pendingYours: A change is waiting on your answer
catalogStock.pendingTheirs: A change you proposed is waiting on the vendor

storageFee.title: What you should be charging
storageFee.notBilledCaption: The platform doesn't track, invoice or chase this — it's what you should be charging, worked out from your own policy. Collecting it is between you and the vendor.
storageFee.notOfferedHint: Storage-based pricing is switched off in your policies, so no rent is quoted for this line.
storageFee.sizeCaption: Shown so you can sanity-check the rate — a pallet and an envelope cost the same today. Size is not part of the calculation.

suspension.title: Storefront
suspension.suspendHint: Suspending takes it off the storefront so customers can no longer buy it. Nothing here is automatic — the platform never suspends on your behalf.
suspension.bySystem: Suspended by the platform, not by you — most often because the vendor's delivery agency went inactive or their connection needs re-approval. Only they can lift it.
suspension.dialogBody: It leaves the storefront immediately and customers can no longer buy it. Every variant of the product is affected. You can put it back at any time.
suspension.noteHint: Optional, but it's the only explanation the vendor gets. Up to {{max}} characters.
suspension.blockedTitle: This product can't go back on sale yet
suspension.blockedUnknown: The vendor has something to resolve before this product can be activated.

depot.dialogTitle: Move this product to another depot
depot.dialogBody: Which of your buildings holds these goods. Every variant of the product moves together, and the vendor is notified.
depot.followPrimaryHint: The product follows whichever depot is first in your list, and keeps following it if you reorder them.
depot.inFlightWarning: The pickup address is resolved fresh on every read, so this also redirects collection for shipments already in flight — an agent who hasn't collected yet will be sent to the new building.

summary.monthlyEstimateHint: What you should be charging, not billed

stock.availableHint: On hand minus units already reserved by in-flight orders. This is what is genuinely left.

requests.filterDescription: Narrow to what's waiting on you, or to one status.
requests.empty: No stock changes have been raised.
requests.emptyHint: When a vendor proposes a new quantity for a SKU you warehouse — or you propose one to them — it appears here for the other side to answer.
requests.emptyNoMatch: No stock changes match your filters.
requests.absoluteHint: The requested figure is the absolute target, not an adjustment — approving makes the SKU read exactly that.
requests.drift: The quantity moved since this was raised: the proposer saw {{before}}, it now reads {{current}}. Approving still applies the requested figure.
requests.quantityBeforeHint: What the proposer was looking at
requests.quantityAtApply: The SKU held {{quantity}} at the moment it was replaced.
requests.reasonPlaceholder: Why not? Shown to the vendor — e.g. I counted 118, not 90
requests.staleNotice: The other side answered this first. It's been reloaded — read the outcome above rather than trying again.
requests.approvedToast: Approved. The recorded quantity has been updated.
requests.raisedToast: Proposed. The vendor has to approve it before the quantity changes.
requests.raiseBody: Nothing changes until the vendor approves. Say what you counted — it's what they'll weigh your figure against.
requests.quantityHint: The absolute figure the SKU should read, not an adjustment. Zero is allowed — a warehouse can be emptied.
requests.notePlaceholder: e.g. Counted 118 on the shelf this morning
requests.noteHint: Optional, but it's what the vendor weighs your figure against.

detail.unassignedHint: The product names a location you have since deleted, so we can't say which building holds it. Move it to a real depot below. Deliveries still route to your primary location in the meantime.
detail.storageFeeCaption: Your per-SKU storage rate. Not billed yet — this record is what unblocks it.
